assertions.rationale: The response uses Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore and Duende.IdentityServer.AspNetIdentity; it never references the Duende.UserManagement.IdentityServer8 package.

assertions.assertion: Adds Duende.Storage.Sqlite NuGet package (or references it)
assertions.rationale: Storage is provided by Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Sqlite, not the Duende.Storage.Sqlite package.

assertions.assertion: Calls AddUserManagement() on the IdentityServer builder with a configuration lambda
assertions.rationale: The response calls AddAspNetIdentity<IdentityUser>() instead; there is no AddUserManagement() call.

assertions.assertion: Calls AddSqliteStore() inside the AddUserManagement options lambda (not at top level)
assertions.rationale: Storage is configured via AddDbContext/UseSqlite at the top level; AddSqliteStore() is never used.

assertions.assertion: Calls IDatabaseSchema.CreateIfNotExistsAsync() to ensure database schema exists
